shared_elements: bearded male figures in strict profile
military campaign scene with troops in file
conical/pointed helmets and beards rendered with fine incised lines
low-relief frieze on a horizontal rectangular panel
justification: Both are horizontal low-relief military friezes with the same repertoire: bearded profile figures in pointed helmets drawing composite bows, files of spearmen, and a spoked-wheel vehicle, all rendered with identical conventions of flattened profile bodies, patterned beards and incised drapery lines. The chief difference in content is the setting: A is a siege, with the archers on a wheeled siege engine assaulting a crenellated walled city with towers and an arched gate, while B is an open-field procession centred on a horse-drawn chariot with no architecture.
